nodes.label: gppu.iot - IoT Primitives, MQTT Plumbing & Control Mixins
nodes.norm_label: gppu.iot - iot primitives, mqtt plumbing & control mixins

nodes.label: setuptools_scm tag selection
nodes.rationale: It reads gppu/v* tags only so that other modules' tags do not perturb the version.

nodes.label: Sidecar manifests
nodes.rationale: Injection needs its own process, so a mode cannot be both inline and injected.

nodes.label: gppu.Env
nodes.rationale: Env holds what the app was configured with, not what the app is doing; the app's objects and their state live in the app, never in Env.

nodes.label: AppService.from_mqtt
nodes.rationale: Console apps and apps that restart to apply configuration need no background connection for configuration.

nodes.label: MqttMixin
nodes.rationale: The mqtt library is not a service: each service owns its broker login, identifier, and status/<service> LWT.

nodes.label: config_mqtt topics
nodes.rationale: Destination paths cannot overlap, because delivery order must not decide which configuration wins.

nodes.label: gppu.desktop
nodes.rationale: The module adds no navigation, parsing, or index of its own; every listing, metadata lookup, and byte read below a source goes to gppufs.

nodes.label: gppu.chrome
nodes.rationale: The module expects a POSIX host because its process handling calls pgrep and kill.

nodes.label: Container.walk
nodes.rationale: gppu owns source access, exclusions, handler readings and archive extraction; the consumer owns persistence, run state and progress.

nodes.label: M365 Provider
nodes.rationale: A last-run timestamp must not replace the API's delta protocol.

nodes.label: Location (configuration)
nodes.rationale: Provider-specific access and file naming remain Provider configuration; access and storage are not Location fields.

nodes.label: row_fn
nodes.rationale: row_fn runs on the main thread during population, so it should only build cells.
